_why: P5-005 requires recorded wire fixtures. This is NOT a recorded provider response. It reproduces the documented response shape for a page that is NOT the last one.
_the_point_of_this_fixture: Google documents `nextPageToken` and `nextSyncToken` as MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE: nextPageToken is "Omitted if no further results are available, in which case nextSyncToken is provided", and nextSyncToken is "Omitted if further results are available, in which case nextPageToken is provided". A page with more results therefore CANNOT carry a sync token. An earlier test of mine asserted a body carrying both, which Google cannot produce.
_sanitized: Event identifiers are placeholders. Nothing here comes from a calendar.
